text:
maya: Heads-up — kicking off dev/stg bring-up for cedar-14b (float32 baseline). Plan: baseline sanity run, then q8 -> q4 quant experiments, plus KV cache and latency smoke. Who can watch for infra issues?
ankit: I can take infra. What's the quant path and smoke set size?
maya: quick plan: 1) float32 baseline 2) PTQ q8 3) AWQ q4. Smoke set = 10 prompts (det & fuzz). Check instruction following, code generation, arithmetic, and safety. Also run KV prefix test.
devon: I'll curate the 10 prompts (math, edge-case instructions, short code gen, hallucination probes). Pushing prompt list to repo in a sec.
maya: Link: https://git.redwood/internal/eng-ml/onboard/cedar14b/smoke-prompts.md :eyes:
infra-bot: Deployment triggered: cedar-14b@devstg -> pool-devstg-3. job_id=dj-4532. status=queued.
ankit: Watching memory/ooms. If OOM, fallback plan -> q8 or shard by 8.
maya: Metrics to capture: token-level diffs, instruction pass/fail, code-run correctness (unit tests), p50/p95 latency. Runtime flag: set REDWOOD_KERNELS=optimized-q4 for q4 runs.
sophia: For regressions, let's run a small labeled eval (50 examples) from our MMLU/code subset. Block if accuracy drops >3% vs baseline.
devon: Noted — will include one deterministic code/unit test for each code prompt. Also add a date/fact prompt for hallucination check.
maya: infra-bot: status=running on host=gpu-7. logs: "Loading model shard 2/4", "KV cache init ok".
qa-bot: Quick smoke results uploaded: float32 baseline -> instr 10/10, code correct 9/10; q8 -> instr 9/10, code 8/10; q4 -> instr 7/10, code 6/10. Artifact: s3://redwood-artifacts/cedar14b/devstg/smoke-1949001234.log
ankit: Can we lock seeds for determinism? use seed=42, max_new_tokens=128, temperature=0.0, sampling=greedy.
maya: Agreed. Also run latency sweep batch_sizes=[1,4,8] target p50(batch1) < 120ms.
devon: Found a strange q4 code output — return got cast to string. Pasting snippet:
devon: ```text
Prompt: "Write a Python function that returns the sum of a list"
Baseline:
def sum_list(xs):
    return sum(xs)
Q4 output:
def sum_list(xs):
    total = 0
    for x in xs:
        total += x
    return str(total)
```
maya: Yikes. Add that to the regression set. Looks like a quant-induced token swap or generation glitch.
ankit: I grabbed heap/profile snapshot — no obvious OOM. Runtime config shows sampling_strategy=greedy, top_k=1. So should be deterministic. Might be tokenization id mapping in q4 kernels.
sophia: I'll schedule the 50-ex eval harness overnight and post metrics AM. If q4 drop >3% we flag as regression and keep q8 as default.
maya: Next steps (short): 1) devon adds failing example to blocked-regressions; 2) sophia runs 50-ex eval with seed42; 3) if q4 regression > threshold -> state=quant-warning, keep q8 by default; 4) open PR w/ artifacts/logs + doc.
devon: I'll open PR and tag it onboard/cedar-14b + regression:q4.
sophia: product okayed mid-week prioritization.
infra-bot: Job dj-4532 complete: status=success. artifacts -> s3://redwood-artifacts/cedar14b/devstg/smoke-1949001234.log
maya: Thanks everyone. If q8 looks good we'll schedule a small dedicated canary next week (low qps) and follow rollout playbook. :thumbsup:
